name: Percher's Jacket
text:
This leather jacket is studded with bones and trimmed with a mantle of raptor feathers that help keep rain off the wearer's shoulders. This +1 studded leather armor grants a +2 item bonus to Survival checks to track.

Activate—Sudden Dive 2

Frequency once per day

---
Effect The feather mantle extends into gliding wings. You Fly up to double your Speed, but you must move in a straight line and descend at least 5 feet from your starting position. If you don't have any other means of flying and are still in the air at the end of your movement, you then fall.
